description: This file defines React components and utility functions for generating Open Graph images for meetings, apps, and generic content, including styling and URL construction logic.

methods.name: joinMultipleNames
methods.description: Concatenates multiple names into a string, separated by commas and an ampersand for the last name.

methods.name: makeAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Converts a relative URL to an absolute URL using CAL_URL if it is not already absolute.

methods.name: getOGImageVersion
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash based on OG_ASSETS data and additional inputs to version OG images.

methods.name: constructMeetingImage
methods.description: Builds a URL for a meeting OG image with specified profile and users.

methods.name: constructAppImage
methods.description: Builds a URL for an app OG image with specified app details.

methods.name: constructGenericImage
methods.description: Builds a URL for a generic OG image with specified title and description.
